type Carried[SEnvelope any, SHandle any, Item any] struct{Message SEnvelope `json:"message"`; Back runtime.Nullable[SHandle] `json:"back"`; Page Page[Item] `json:"page"`}
type Envelope struct{Version int64 `json:"version"`; Kind string `json:"kind"`; ID runtime.Optional[string] `json:"id,omitzero"`; Method runtime.Optional[string] `json:"method,omitzero"`; Params runtime.Optional[any] `json:"params,omitzero"`; Result runtime.Optional[any] `json:"result,omitzero"`; Error runtime.Optional[any] `json:"error,omitzero"`; Event runtime.Optional[string] `json:"event,omitzero"`; Data runtime.Optional[any] `json:"data,omitzero"`; Traceparent runtime.Optional[string] `json:"traceparent,omitzero"`; Tracestate runtime.Optional[string] `json:"tracestate,omitzero"`; Meta runtime.Optional[map[string]string] `json:"meta,omitzero"`}
type Handle struct{Channel int64 `json:"channel"`}
type LiteralText string
type OptionKind string
type OptionNone struct{}
type OptionSomeValue[T any] struct{Value T}
type Option[T any] struct{None *OptionNone; Some *OptionSomeValue[T]}
type Page[T any] struct{Items []T `json:"items"`; Next runtime.Optional[runtime.Nullable[string]] `json:"next,omitzero"`}
type Part struct{Count *PartCountValue; Image *PartImage; Text *TextPart}
type PartCountValue struct{Value int64}
type PartImage struct{URL string `json:"url"`; Alt runtime.Optional[runtime.Nullable[string]] `json:"alt,omitzero"`}
type PartKind string
type Parts Page[Part]
type PartsRequest struct{After runtime.Optional[runtime.Nullable[string]] `json:"after,omitzero"`}
type ResultErrValue[T any, E any] struct{Value E}
type ResultKind string
type ResultOkValue[T any, E any] struct{Value T}
type Result[T any, E any] struct{Err *ResultErrValue[T, E]; Ok *ResultOkValue[T, E]}
type RichPart struct{Count *PartCountValue; Image *PartImage; Text *TextPart; Table *RichPartTable}
type RichPartKind string
type RichPartTable struct{Rows []runtime.Nullable[string] `json:"rows"`}
type Tag struct{}
type TextPart struct{Type LiteralText `json:"type"`; Body string `json:"body"`}
var Errors = []string{…}
